mentions.story: Ask YC: Do you have a cool Arduino project?
mentions.text:
I got one a few months ago and just started doing baby projects. Here's my first project: [link]

It's just a knock sensor that prints a plot of the knocks to the screen. a "poor man's oscilliscope" sort of.

My next project is a variation on this haptic ultrasonic hat: [course]

I'll post it a writeup if anyone's curious.
